responsibility: This file builds GCC statement and function-body trees for the Modula-2 frontend. It owns function prologue/epilogue setup and finalization, assignment, goto and label emission, call construction and argument accumulation, return statements, conditional jumps, inline asm emission, set include/exclude update code, and module-initialization function generation, so it is the statement-level lowering layer that turns frontend control-flow and side-effecting operations into generic GCC statement lists.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the m2statement group: it contains the real statement, call, control-flow, and function-finalization tree construction logic, whereas m2statement.h declares the native API and m2statement.def provides the Modula-2 foreign specification.
